why_processed_fan_teacher_audit_is_incon.consequence: Finite differences of the saved fan targets mix physical PDE derivatives with interpolation, clipping/flooring, endpoint overwrite, front-extraction, moving-domain, and sparse-time effects.
why_processed_fan_teacher_audit_is_incon.diagnostic_red_flag: At Nc=0 the corrected processed-fan teacher MSE is much larger than the old characteristic teacher MSE even though the conservative equation and moving-coordinate derivation must reduce consistently at the incompressible limit.
why_processed_fan_teacher_audit_is_incon.RH_vs_FD_observation: RH and FD Xdot produce similar corrected teacher residual magnitudes, so front-speed closure choice is not the dominant cause of the processed-fan audit discrepancy.

scientific_interpretation: B2O validates the corrected residual implementation algebra, but does not yet validate the residual against the underlying numerical teacher. The saved fan dataset is a supervised-learning representation, not an appropriate native conservation stencil. A source-native Godunov audit is required before any corrected Stage-2 optimizer is created.
prohibited_conclusions: the corrected residual is validated by the processed-fan audit
RH Xdot should be rejected in favor of FD Xdot based on B2O
